title: Design review checklist for Operational Excellence - Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework | Microsoft Learn
scope: All numbered rows in the English WAF Operational Excellence design review checklist
fingerprintScope: canonical-json-v1 payload {id,code,recommendation}: trimmed Markdown table cells, excluding checkbox and page/fetch metadata

items.title: Define your standard practices to develop and operate your workload.

payload.recommendation: **Define your standard practices to develop and operate your workload.** Align team members' specializations to clear practices for designing, deploying, and operating the workload. Establish accountability and create a culture that promotes continuous improvement and a blameless culture that supports learning.

items.title: Use standardization as a way to make routine, ad-hoc, and emergency operations consistent and predictable.

payload.recommendation: Use standardization as a way to make routine, ad-hoc, and emergency operations consistent and predictable.

items.title: Formalize processes across the full software development lifecycle, from ideation to delivery, and make them transparent to the team and stakeholders.

payload.recommendation: Formalize processes across the full software development lifecycle, from ideation to delivery, and make them transparent to the team and stakeholders.

items.title: Enhance software development and quality assurance

payload.recommendation: **Enhance software development and quality assurance** by implementing industry-standard practices. Ensure clear role definitions and consistent processes by standardizing tools, source control, design patterns, documentation, and style guides.

items.title: Use a standardized infrastructure as code (IaC) approach to prepare resources and configurations.

payload.recommendation: **Use a standardized infrastructure as code (IaC) approach to prepare resources and configurations.** Use IaC to ensure consistent styles, modularization, and quality assurance. Prefer declarative over imperative approaches when practical.

items.title: Build a workload supply chain that drives changes

payload.recommendation: **Build a workload supply chain that drives changes** through predictable, automated pipelines. Ensure these pipelines test and promote changes across all environments and quality gates. Incorporate comprehensive testing.
**Design a monitoring stack** that captures operational telemetry, metrics, and logs from the workload's infrastructure and code to validate design decisions and guide future improvements.

items.title: Establish a clear, structured incident management process

payload.recommendation: **Establish a clear, structured incident management process** with defined roles, documented procedures, and architecture designed for rapid detection, diagnosis, and recovery.

items.title: Enhance the quality of your workload

payload.recommendation: **Enhance the quality of your workload** by adopting testing practices that align with business objectives and uphold quality standards.

items.title: Design automation to be reliable, secure, and maintainable

payload.recommendation: **Design automation to be reliable, secure, and maintainable** across the workload lifecycle. Automate repetitive, procedural tasks that deliver clear return on investment.

items.title: Clearly define your workload's safe deployment practices.

payload.recommendation: **Clearly define your workload's safe deployment practices.** Focus on small, incremental releases with quality gates. Use modern deployment patterns and progressive exposure to manage risk. Plan for both routine and emergency deployments.
